repos.name: AltStore Official
repos.description: The official AltStore source by Riley Testut. Contains Delta emulator, Clip clipboard manager, and official AltStore releases.
repos.note: The most trusted source in the ecosystem. Start here.

repos.name: SideStore Community
repos.description: Official SideStore community source. Hand-curated emulators and jailbreak tools including Delta, PPSSPP, Mini vMac, unc0ver, iDOS, and Odyssey.
repos.note: Curated by the SideStore team. High quality, safe picks only.

repos.name: Quantum Source V1
repos.description: Auto-updated every 30 minutes via Python script. Contains emulators, jailbreak tools, utilities, and MacDirtyCow-powered apps like WDBRemoveThreeAppLimit.
repos.note: Script auto-syncs from official dev repos. Always up to date.

repos.name: Quantum Plus V2
repos.description: Extended Quantum Source with tweaked apps (++), free streaming, cracked apps, and modified social media apps on top of the emulator base.
repos.note: Best all-in-one repo for emulators and tweaked apps.

repos.name: AltStore Complete
repos.description: Auto-aggregates all official AltStore sources into one JSON. Updated automatically whenever upstream repos change.
repos.note: One URL that combines every official source automatically.

repos.name: CyPwn IPA Library
repos.description: Massive library of tweaked apps, cracked IPAs, TrollStore TIPA files, and jailbreak tools. One of the most comprehensive actively maintained repos.
repos.note: One of the largest and most active repos. Trusted by thousands.

repos.name: WuXu's Library++
repos.description: One of the largest IPA repositories for iOS. Updated 1-2 times per week with the latest cracked, tweaked, and ++ apps.
repos.note: High consistency update schedule. Excellent quality control.

repos.name: App Testers Repo
repos.description: One of the biggest IPA databases with over 2000 files. Best accessed via GBox due to the large volume of entries.
repos.note: Slow to load in AltStore. Recommended with GBox.

repos.name: Starfiles Community
repos.description: Over 1000 IPAs including cracked apps, tweaked social apps, and jailbreak utilities. Optimized URL for GBox compatibility.
repos.note: Use with GBox IPA installer for best experience.

repos.name: qnblackcat Repo
repos.description: Personal repo by qnblackcat. Known for uYou+ (best YouTube tweak for iOS), tweaked Reddit, Instagram, and other social media apps.
repos.note: Best known for uYou+. Top YouTube tweak in the community.

repos.name: Randomblock1 Source
repos.description: YouTube++, Snapchat++, IGRocket, Watusi (WhatsApp tweak), RetroArch, Kodi, and other popular tweaked and utility apps.
repos.note: Great for social media tweaks. Actively maintained on GitHub.

repos.name: OatmealDome - DolphiniOS
repos.description: Official source for DolphiniOS, a GameCube and Wii emulator for iOS 12+. No jailbreak required. Maintained directly by the developer.
repos.note: Official developer source.

repos.name: Flyinghead - Flycast
repos.description: Official source for Flycast, a Sega Dreamcast, Naomi, and Atomiswave emulator for iOS. Nightly builds from GitHub Actions.
repos.note: Only source for Flycast on iOS.

repos.name: Provenance Emulator
repos.description: Official source for Provenance, a powerful multi-system emulator supporting NES, SNES, GBA, Genesis, PS1, and many other classic consoles.
repos.note: The reference multi-console emulator for iOS.

repos.name: RetroArch iOS
repos.description: Official RetroArch nightly builds for iOS from libretro's buildbot. Supports PS1, N64, GBA, SNES, and dozens of other systems via cores.
repos.note: Official libretro buildbot. Definitive multi-system emulator.

repos.name: UTM Virtual Machine
repos.description: Official UTM source. Run full Windows, Linux, Android VMs on your iPhone or iPad. Open-source, no jailbreak required.
repos.note: Open-source project. Runs real operating systems on iOS.

repos.name: iSH Shell
repos.description: Official source for iSH, a fully functional Alpine Linux shell environment for iOS. Open-source with active development.
repos.note: Open-source. Full Alpine Linux on iOS.

repos.name: LiveContainer Official
repos.description: Official LiveContainer source from GitHub. Run multiple sideloaded apps in a single container, bypassing the 3-app limit on free accounts.
repos.note: Direct from GitHub. Essential for LiveContainer users.

repos.name: Burrito's AltStore
repos.description: Curated repo with UTM, Provenance, iNDS (Nintendo DS emulator), unc0ver, Sileo Demo, and appdb. Focused on quality over quantity.
repos.note: Small but well-maintained. Good for lesser-known emulators.

repos.name: NineAnimator Nightly
repos.description: Official nightly builds of NineAnimator, a free open-source anime streaming app for iOS with support for numerous streaming sources.
repos.note: Open-source. Best free anime streaming app for iOS.

repos.name: PokeMMO Source
repos.description: Official distribution channel for PokeMMO on iOS. Free-to-play multiplayer Pokemon RPG with active servers.
repos.note: Official PokeMMO source.

repos.name: Odyssey Jailbreak
repos.description: Official AltStore source for the Odyssey jailbreak by CoolStar. Semi-untethered jailbreak for iOS 13.0 through 13.7.
repos.note: iOS 13.0-13.7 only.

repos.name: Taurine Jailbreak
repos.description: Official source for the Taurine jailbreak by CoolStar and the Odyssey Team. Semi-untethered jailbreak for iOS 14.0 through 14.3.
repos.note: iOS 14.0-14.3 only.

repos.name: EeveeSpotify
repos.description: Open-source Spotify tweak that unlocks Premium features. Lighter and less detectable than other Spotify mods. Actively maintained on GitHub.
repos.note: Open-source. Best alternative Spotify tweak.

repos.name: Omni Repository
repos.description: Community-maintained repo by Omni Development. Tweaked apps and utilities. Active GitHub project with regular commits.
repos.note: Active GitHub project. Smaller but growing community.

repos.name: EthMods (fka SultanMods)
repos.description: Formerly SultanMods, now maintained by EthSign. Contains tweaked social and utility apps under active maintenance.
repos.note: Rebranded from SultanMods. Still active under new team.

repos.name: SideStore Nightly
repos.description: Official nightly builds of SideStore from GitHub Actions CI. Latest features before stable release. May contain bugs.
repos.note: Auto-built from GitHub. Beta quality, use with caution.

repos.name: Gamr13 Repo
repos.description: Community AltStore source by Gamr13. Tweaked apps and utilities hosted transparently on GitHub.
repos.note: Small personal repo. Transparent GitHub hosting.

repos.name: Niantic Wayfarer
repos.description: Unofficial Niantic Wayfarer app for iOS with dark mode and OPR Brainstorming support. Useful for Pokemon GO and Ingress players.
repos.note: Niche use case. Only iOS source for this app.

repos.name: FloridaMan Source
repos.description: Legacy source with older jailbreak tools: unc0ver, Chimera, Sileo package manager, and PlankFilza. For older iOS versions only.
repos.note: Legacy tools only. Not actively maintained.

repos.name: Havoc Repo
repos.description: Havoc is a well-known premium tweak store from the jailbreak world, now available as an AltStore source. Mix of free and paid content.
repos.note: Some apps are paid. Trusted name from the jailbreak scene.

repos.name: bunduuk Personal Repo
repos.description: Personal AltStore source by bunduuk. Small and infrequently updated but publicly hosted on GitHub.
repos.note: Small personal repo. Transparent GitHub hosting.

repos.name: driftywinds Repo
repos.description: Actively maintained community repo last updated Feb 2026. Includes YTLite + Tweaks, InstaMulti, YT Music Ultimate, Spotify tweaked, Feather IPA installer, and Balatro cracked. Compatible with SideStore, AltStore, and most sideloading tools.
repos.note: Verified active as of Feb 2026. Good mix of tweaked social apps.

repos.name: Streamer App Repo
repos.description: Official source for Streamer, an ad-free streaming app for iOS and tvOS. Supports Trakt, Chromecast, Real-Debrid, multi-language subtitles, VLC/Infuse player integration, and Stremio addons.
repos.note: Official GitHub source. Active project with regular updates.

repos.name: dayanch96 Workshop
repos.description: Official repo by dayanch96 (DAN), author of YTLite/YouTube Plus. Contains YouTube Plus, YT Music Ultimate, Infuse Plus (unlocked premium), and more. Compatible with AltStore, SideStore, ESign, and GBox.
repos.note: Source directly from the tweak developer. Top-tier YouTube tweak author.

repos.name: YTLitePlus Altstore
repos.description: AltStore source for YTLitePlus, an enhanced YouTube tweak combining YTLite with iSponsorBlock, Return YouTube Dislikes, YouPiP, OLED dark mode, and 20+ other tweaks in one IPA.
repos.note: Note: base YTLitePlus project is deprecated. Use dayanch96 Workshop for active builds.

repos.name: Feather IPA Installer
repos.description: Official source for Feather, an on-device IPA installer and signer. Supports AltStore repo format, tweak injection at signing time, multiple certificate imports, and OTA install over Wi-Fi.
repos.note: Open-source. One of the best free on-device IPA signers available.

repos.name: PPSSPP Official
repos.description: Official AltStore source for PPSSPP, the PlayStation Portable emulator for iOS. Both free and Gold (paid) versions available directly from the developer.
repos.note: Official PPSSPP source from the developer.

repos.name: Mini vMac
repos.description: Official source for Mini vMac, a classic Mac Plus emulator for iOS. Run vintage Mac software from the late 1980s on your iPhone.
repos.note: Official source from the developer.

repos.name: Balackburn Repo
repos.description: Personal repo by Balackburn hosting YTLitePlus builds. Linked from the official YTLitePlus release pipeline on Codeberg.
repos.note: Personal GitHub repo. Transparent and open-source.

repos.name: App Testers Repo v2
repos.description: Second endpoint of App Testers, hosts an alternate mirror of the full IPA database. Use if the primary repo.apptesters.org is slow.
repos.note: Mirror of the main App Testers repo. Use as fallback.

repos.name: AltStore CDN Official
repos.description: Direct CDN endpoint for the official AltStore apps JSON. Same content as apps.altstore.io but served from Altstore's CDN. More reliable in some regions.
repos.note: Official AltStore CDN. Use if apps.altstore.io is unreachable.

repos.name: SpotC (yodaluca23)
repos.description: Real direct JSON endpoint for SpotC Spotify tweak repo by yodaluca23. Spotify without ads, unlimited skips, high quality audio. Replaces the old tiny.one redirect.
repos.note: Direct GitHub raw JSON. No redirect. Verified working.
